description:
Delete the Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) buy transaction from your portfolio. 

Starting state: JStock is open on the Portfolio Management tab. The 'My Portfolio' contains three buy transactions: Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), and NVIDIA (NVDA).

Goal: Remove the MSFT transaction so that only AAPL and NVDA remain. 

Steps:
1. Locate the Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) transaction in the table.
2. Delete it (right-click > Delete, or use the Delete key/button).
3. Confirm the deletion if prompted.
4. Ensure AAPL and NVDA transactions remain untouched.
